auth.welcome: Your receipts, services and pricing history stay private to your account.
auth.resetMessage: We'll email you a secure link to choose a new password.
auth.heroTitle: Receipts worthy of the service you provide.
auth.heroDescription: Historic pricing, immutable receipt numbers and A4-ready PDFs — all private to your account, all in pounds sterling.
auth.heroIsolation: Owner-only data isolation on every record.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Every receipt you have generated, newest first. Records are immutable once issued.
dashboard.generateNewDesc: Prefilled with today's date and current service pricing
dashboard.noReceiptsSearchDesc: Try a different receipt number, customer name or service.
dashboard.noReceiptsDesc: Generate your first receipt to start building your library.

services.title: Services
services.description: Each service keeps a full price history. Editing a price closes the previous period and opens a new one — past receipts never change.

managers.title: Managers
managers.description: Add new users to the platform. They will be able to sign in and upload their receipts using the shared samples.
managers.addManagerDescription: Create a new account. The new manager will automatically have sample services generated for them when their account is created.
managers.secureIsolationDescription: Each manager's data is isolated. They can only see receipts and services that they create. Sample services are automatically provisioned upon account creation.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your business profile and preferences.
settings.languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the interface.
settings.businessNameDesc: Shown in the app header and printed on new receipts.
settings.businessLogoDesc: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG · up to 2 MB. Stored privately and served through short-lived signed links.
settings.pushNotificationsDesc: Get notified when managers create new receipts.
settings.notSupported: Push notifications are not supported in this browser
settings.blocked: You have blocked notifications in your browser settings.
